value.rationale: The all-parameter forced-three-symbol threshold is a natural factor-language invariant for the recently highlighted cyclic automatic substitution. It is exactly quadratic in the run parameter, independent of alphabet size, and has q explicitly characterized distinct extremizers. This nontrivial structural result does not follow from merely bounding ordinary run length or computing finite samples.
